parent_evidence.debug_review: G6b refusal-v1/result.json: frozen candidate 32/32; original 33/34 preserved

protocol.source_design: Fresh narratives, explicit precision/condition/direction and complementary-attribute boundaries, 6 strata. Family/content/question disjoint from prior Ask World baselines and refusal development set. No prompts or rubric changed after construction.
protocol.once_only: One material-hash lock for both arms, exclusive stage markers and per-request intent; no retry or result-driven tuning. Format/citation repair is inherited production behavior and every native attempt is retained.
protocol.judge: Two blinded mixed-arm batches of 32, whole-family assignment; unchanged calibrated rubric; neutral row IDs.

acceptance.integrity: 64 valid outputs, 64 valid and decided teacher reviews, 100% reference acceptance, unchanged frozen config/snapshot, no unknown calls
acceptance.improvement: candidate strictly fewer over-refusals among 16 answerable cases; baseline zero means improvement inconclusive
acceptance.hallucination: candidate false answers, unsupported claims and answer inconsistencies each zero and no increase over baseline
acceptance.conflicts: candidate conflict failures zero and no increase over baseline
acceptance.overall: candidate semantic pass >= 95% (>=31/32), and count >= baseline

protocol.statistics: Report paired positive-case discordant wins/losses and exact two-sided sign-test p descriptively; not an acceptance gate and no population-rate/zero-risk claim. Two cases per family are correlated.
protocol.scope: Generation layer only, not retrieval/Evidence/governance/UI or author acceptance. Frozen holdout becomes consumed after startup irrespective of results.
